name: Two-Obstruction PC-Minor Basis for Rank-Two Ample Classes
statement: A finite partial cube is the graph of an ample class of VC dimension at most two if and only if it has no pc-minor isomorphic to $Q_3$ or $C_6$. Both obstructions are pc-minimal outside the class.
proof: Excluding $Q_3$ imposes VC dimension at most two. Proposition 5 of the cited source shows that, within this rank bound, excluding $C_6=Q_3^{--}$ is exactly ampleness. A proper pc-minor of $Q_3$ cannot shatter all three coordinates, and proper pc-minors of $C_6$ are trees or squares; all are ample of VC dimension at most two.
